firewall-aiops v0.1.0 — Initial Preview Release

- Introduces governed firewall operations for OPNsense and pfSense via unified REST API tools.
- Offers 32 tools covering system status, firewall/NAT rules, aliases, VPN, DHCP, diagnostics, and three flagship root-cause analyses.
- All state-changing actions are governed (policy engine, audit log, risk/undo framework).
- Credentials are stored securely (AES-128 encrypted, not plaintext); all operations audited locally.
- Preview/mock-only: commands are validated but not run against a live firewall.
